# Chifbay

> Private boat charter company in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal. One boat, one group at a time — never a shared tour. Whole-boat flat pricing for up to 5 guests, direct online booking with live availability and instant card payment.

Chifbay operates a single private boat, a 2026 Karnic R8S (9 metres, Mercury V8 300hp), crewed by two Chifbay skippers on every trip. Every trip is exclusive to one group — Chifbay never mixes guests from different bookings on the same boat. There is a bathroom on board. Local wine, poncha, beer, soft drinks and snacks are included in the price on every trip, at no extra charge.

Two trips are offered, both departing Marina do Funchal, Pontoon C:

- **Day Trip** — departs 10:00 or 14:00. 2h30 (€500, turns at Ribeira Brava) or 3h (€600, continues to Ponta do Sol with a filmed video). Swimming and paddle boarding at Fajã dos Padres, a cove reachable only by boat. Drone footage included.
- **Sunset Trip** — departs 18:30. 2h (€400, turns at Cabo Girão) or 2h30 (€500, continues to Ribeira Brava). No swimming (the water is too cold by then). Drone footage included.

All prices are a flat rate for the whole boat, not per person.
